read_only_findings: Strict configuration rejects unsupported nested report.benchmark_contract, enabled lineage/bundle, and managed qualification flags instead of dropping their policies. None remains explicit legacy off.

The shared store bounds JSON and exact schema identities; current RUNNING authority and same-transaction artifact dependencies are checked on both sides of insertion. Historical lookup remains metadata-only, does not create schema and does not grant current execution permission.

Preparation hashes B1 snapshots and copies the evaluator entrypoint before the effect/SQL writer; identities captured before reads are rechecked, and large sealed/input/result reads stay outside the writer.
The evaluator's actual command uses the copied absolute entrypoint and interpreter, cwd is attempt-local work, and reserved manifest/output environment paths override inherited/configured values.

Native completion does not call the legacy existing-output shortcut or shared failure-marker path. Zero observations, invalid/unknown adapter labels and process failure have distinct storage semantics.

Result artifact registration, observation registration, lifecycle closure and terminal IDs share the current-attempt SQL transaction. Final checks include both result tables and pinned input metadata after later terminal triggers.
Explicit retry preserves prior work and training source, checks the original protocol/input records, and does not move/delete old evaluator output or re-launch training.

The lower legacy qualifier now also reads durable current evaluation binding through a read-only declared catalog. Removing current observation config cannot reauthorize old shared scores; unreadable/invalid native routing/database and malformed bound declaration fail closed.
Spec fingerprints, protocol fingerprints, occurrence IDs and process outcomes remain separate; documentation does not promote adapter-reported validity to a scientific verdict.

documentation.final_review: Read the complete final document without modifying production or tests. The added paragraph explicitly records unbound prelaunch staging and fresh attempt IDs, with no B1-style cross-prelaunch-failure deduplication or automatic cleanup claim. It also states that the independent 64 KiB input-manifest and attempt-binding metadata limits may reject a declaration before its nominal 32-input limit, without authorizing Popen. These clarifications match the reviewed implementation and narrow its claims; no new B2 blocker was found.

limits: The copied entrypoint is not a closure of imports, interpreter packages, inherited environment or external datasets.
Attempt directories and read-only artifact inodes are cooperative IO boundaries, not an OS sandbox against a hostile same-UID worker.
Pre-launch preparation can leave unbound staging after failure; there is no automatic recovery/garbage collection or claim of deduplication across fresh prelaunch attempt IDs.
Filesystem effects and SQLite commits are not atomic; uncertain publication remains HOLD and historical metadata alone does not prove confirmed current completion.
Observation selection, ranking, qualification, repeated-measurement accounting and explicit replication admission are not implemented by this slice.
No paid provider, real GPU/CPU workload, holdout read, deployment, measured throughput improvement or completion of all V1-05 work is claimed.
